questions.label: (ii)
questions.title: Estimating from a histogram
questions.prompt:
The histogram shows the times, in minutes, that $40$ customers spent in a store.

Estimate the mean time using class centres.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on minutes and frequency axes. Marked on the horizontal axis: 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50; vertical axis: 5, 10, 15. Read the question for what it asks.

questions.title: Reading a histogram
questions.prompt: The histogram shows the waiting times of $30$ patients. What percentage waited $30$ minutes or more? Give one decimal place.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on minutes and y axes; 1 plotted line, curve or set of points is drawn; a region is shaded. Marked on the horizontal axis: 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50; vertical axis: 3, 6, 7, 12. Read the question for what it asks.

questions.title: Median from an ogive
questions.prompt: The cumulative frequency graph for $50$ values is shown. Estimate the median.
hints: The median is at half of 50.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and y axes; 1 plotted line, curve or set of points is drawn. Marked on the horizontal axis: 20, 30, 40, 50, 60; vertical axis: 10, 25, 30, 45, 50. Read the question for what it asks.

questions.title: A tidy standard deviation
questions.prompt: Find the population standard deviation of $2,4,4,4,5,5,7,9$.

questions.title: Mean of two combined groups
questions.prompt: A group of $10$ students has mean mark $70$ and another group of $15$ has mean $80$. Find the mean of all $25$ students.

traps.why: Averaged the two means without weights.

questions.title: Interquartile range from an ogive
questions.prompt: The cumulative frequency graph of $40$ values is shown. Estimate the interquartile range, to two decimal places.
hints: Q₁ at 10, Q₃ at 30 on the vertical axis.

traps.why: Read at 10 and 30 on the x-axis.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and y axes; 1 plotted line, curve or set of points is drawn. Marked on the horizontal axis: 10, 20, 30, 40; vertical axis: 10, 20, 30, 40. Read the question for what it asks.

questions.title: Mean from a dot plot
questions.prompt: The dot plot shows the number of pets owned by $10$ students. Find the mean.

diagram.alt: Diagram for this question; the measurements are given in the question text.

questions.title: Standard deviation of a small set
questions.prompt: Find the population standard deviation of $2,4,4,4,5,5,7,9$.

questions.title: Residual sign
questions.prompt: The regression line is $\hat y=12+3x$. A data point is $(4,20)$. Find the residual.

questions.title: Effect of removing an outlier on the mean
questions.prompt: Five values have mean $12$. One value, $28$, is removed. Find the new mean.

traps.why: Removing a large value lowers the mean.

questions.title: Coefficient of determination meaning
questions.prompt: A regression has $r=0.8$. What percentage of the variation in $y$ is explained by $x$?

questions.title: Cumulative frequency from a table
questions.prompt: Scores $1,2,3,4$ have frequencies $3,7,6,4$. Find the median.

questions.title: Histogram mean estimate
questions.prompt: The histogram shows the masses of $20$ parcels in classes of width $2$ kg. Estimate the mean mass using class centres.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and y axes; 1 plotted line, curve or set of points is drawn; a region is shaded. Marked on the horizontal axis: 0, 2, 4, 6, 8; vertical axis: 2, 4, 6, 8. Read the question for what it asks.

questions.title: Standard deviation change after adding a constant
questions.prompt: Every score in a set with SD $6.5$ is increased by $10$. State the new SD.

traps.why: Adding a constant does not change spread.

questions.title: Reading a regression line from a graph
questions.prompt: The least-squares line shown passes through $(0,12)$ and $(10,42)$. Find its equation.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and y axes; 2 plotted lines, curves or sets of points are drawn. Marked on the horizontal axis: 10; vertical axis: 12, 42. Read the question for what it asks.

questions.title: Pareto chart percentage
questions.prompt: The Pareto chart shows complaint types: Delay $40$, Price $25$, Staff $20$, Other $15$. What percentage do the top two causes account for?

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and y axes; 1 plotted line, curve or set of points is drawn; a region is shaded. Marked on the vertical axis: 20, 40. Read the question for what it asks.

questions.title: Ogive percentile for a cut-off
questions.prompt: Using the ogive in a set of $200$ scores (points $(20,0)$, $(40,30)$, $(60,110)$, $(80,180)$, $(100,200)$), estimate the score at the $90$th percentile by linear interpolation.

questions.title: Predicting and finding a residual from a graph
questions.prompt: The line of best fit shown is $\hat y=2x+1$. The circled point is $(4,12)$. Find its residual and say whether it lies above or below the line.

diagram.alt: Graph drawn on x and y axes; 3 plotted lines, curves or sets of points are drawn. Marked on the horizontal axis: 4; vertical axis: 9, 12. Read the question for what it asks.

questions.title: Combined mean of two groups
questions.prompt: Class A ($20$ students) has mean $65$ and class B ($30$ students) has mean $70$. Find the combined mean.

questions.title: Effect of adding a value on the mean
questions.prompt: The mean of $9$ numbers is $12$. A tenth number is added and the mean becomes $13$. Find the tenth number.

questions.title: Predicting with a fitted line
questions.prompt: Arm span $x$ and height $y$ (cm) satisfy $\hat y=0.9x+18$. Predict the height for an arm span of $170$ cm.

questions.title: Mean after adding an eighteen
questions.prompt: Five numbers have a mean of $12$. The number $18$ is added. Find the new mean.
